faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions on Memzo

faceRecognition.question: How accurate is Memzo's Facial Recognition?
faceRecognition.answer: Our facial recognition technology uses advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze facial features and create unique biometric templates for each person in your photos. The accuracy rate is over 95% in optimal lighting conditions.

faceRecognition.question: How does Face Recognition work for the users?
faceRecognition.answer: Users simply upload their photos to our platform. Our AI automatically scans and identifies faces, creating searchable profiles. Users can then search for specific people across all their photos instantly.

faceRecognition.question: How many guests can find their photos via Face Recognition?
faceRecognition.answer: There's no limit to the number of people our system can recognize. Whether you have 10 or 10,000 people in your photo collection, our facial recognition can identify and organize them all.

photos.question: What photo formats are supported?
photos.answer: We support all major image formats including JPEG, PNG, TIFF, RAW, as well as video formats MP4, AVI, MOV.

pricing.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
pricing.answer: Yes! You can cancel your subscription at any time without any penalties. Your access will remain active until the end of your paid period.
